graph_fields.doc: What the graph is called in messages and in the studio.
graph_fields.name: name

graph_fields.doc: The graph's variables, by name, with their starting values: numbers, strings or booleans.
graph_fields.name: vars

graph_fields.doc: The nodes, as an ARRAY: its order is the order event nodes for the same event run in.
graph_fields.name: nodes

graph_fields.doc: The links, each ["<node>.<pin>", "<node>.<pin>"], from an output to an input.
graph_fields.name: links

graph_fields.doc: The editor's, never read by the runtime: layout, comments.
graph_fields.name: meta

node_fields.doc: Unique in the graph; what links and messages name it by.
node_fields.name: id

node_fields.doc: One of the node types below.
node_fields.name: type

node_fields.doc: The editor's: position, colour, comment. Never read by the runtime.
node_fields.name: meta

args.doc: A trigger_vocab.lua event, or on_player_enter / on_player_leave in a module's graph.
args.name: event

nodes.doc: Where a run starts: when the event happens. Its data outputs are what the event carried -- nil for what it did not.
nodes.name: event

args.doc: A trigger_vocab.lua condition; its arguments are this node's fields, checked by the trigger runtime's checker.
args.name: c

nodes.doc: A trigger condition, asked about the event this run started from.
nodes.name: condition

args.doc: A trigger_vocab.lua action; its arguments are this node's fields.
args.name: a

nodes.doc: A trigger action, done for the event this run started from.
nodes.name: action

args.doc: Used when nothing is linked to the `cond` input.
args.name: cond

nodes.doc: One way or the other on a value: anything but false and nil is true.
nodes.name: branch

nodes.doc: Each exit in turn, in the same tick: 0, then 1, and so on.
nodes.name: sequence

args.doc: How long, at 60 a second. At least 1.
args.name: ticks

nodes.doc: The rest of the run, later, with the same event.
nodes.name: delay

nodes.doc: Through the first time, never again.
nodes.name: once

args.doc: Used when nothing is linked to the `value` input.
args.name: value

args.doc: How much; used when nothing is linked to `value`.
args.name: value

nodes.doc: Add to a numeric variable: a counter.
nodes.name: add_var

args.doc: A number, a string or a boolean.
args.name: value

nodes.doc: a op b, a boolean. Ordering a number against a non-number is false.
nodes.name: compare

nodes.doc: a op b on numbers. Division by zero is zero, not a crash.
nodes.name: math

nodes.doc: A whole number from lo to hi, from the level's own stream, so a replayed level draws the same. Once per run: two readers see one draw.
nodes.name: random
